transcription.testTitle: Compound nouns (e.g. living room, coffee cup)

exercises.instruction: Complete these definitions with the correct compound noun.
items: 1 Your first language is also called your mother ............................ .
2 Stories about the future are called science ............................. .
3 The place where you buy tickets for the theatre or cinema is the box .......................... .
4 Someone who looks after children when the parents are out is a baby-............................ .
5 A long line of cars moving slowly is a traffic ........................... .
6 The room where you eat meals is the ........................... room.
7 Tax you pay on your salary is called ........................... tax.
8 Your sister's husband or your husband's brother is your ...................... -in- ................

exercises.instruction: Label these pictures with the correct compound noun.
Add two more words in each group to form compound nouns.
Match a word from the left with a word from the right to form six compound nouns.
Complete these sentences with a suitable compound noun.
items: 1 Famous .................. ...................... include Elton John, Michael Jackson and Madonna.
2 I brought my toothbrush, but I forgot the ....................... , so I just had to use water.
3 And my hair was wet for ages because I forgot to bring my ......................... .
4 I think the Chinese word is 'ping pong', but we call it ......................... ..................... .

pictures: Picture 1: traffic lights with a car at a red light
Picture 2: man in sunglasses with sun
Picture 6: tin opener opening a can
Picture 8: zebra crossing with pedestrian crossing sign
